device.name: Safe Multi-Agent Robosuite Baxter bimanual arm (MuJoCo model)

facts.text: Safe Multi-Agent Robosuite is an extension of Robosuite that splits the control over a robot across multiple controllers of its joints, one or more per controller
The card's first model is the MJCF document whose root element is '<mujoco model="baxter">'
The Baxter wrapper loads the same file through xml_path_completion("robots/baxter/robot.xml")
The Baxter wrapper describes the robot as a bimanual robot designed by Rethink Robotics
The Baxter wrapper reports the arm type as bimanual

The right arm is a chain of seven hinge joints named right_s0, right_s1, right_e0, right_e1, right_w0, right_w1 and right_w2 with ranges -1.70168..1.70168, -2.147..1.047, -3.05418..3.05418, -0.05..2.618, -3.059..3.059, -1.5708..2.094 and -3.059..3.059
The left arm is the matching chain of seven hinge joints named left_s0, left_s1, left_e0, left_e1, left_w0, left_w1 and left_w2 with the same joint ranges as the right arm

The actuator section declares fourteen motor actuators, one per joint; the control ranges are shoulder pan -50 to 50, shoulder lift -100 to 100, upper elbow -50 to 50, lower elbow -50 to 50, forearm roll -15 to 15, wrist angle -15 to 15 and wrist rotate -15 to 15, repeated for the right and left arms
The head pan joint is inside an XML comment, so the served model has no head joint
The model declares eight contact exclusions between the shoulders, elbows, head and torso
The model declares its eleven meshes as STL files under meshes/
The Baxter wrapper gives both arms the RethinkGripper by default; the gripper is not part of robot.xml

determinism.notes: MuJoCo integrates the MJCF deterministically from the reset state and the model has no random element, so one ctrl sequence and tick count repeat a trajectory; the package's fake backend is deterministic too, but its placeholder motion is not the engine's physics.

gaps: the fake backend is a stand-in for the mujoco library, not MuJoCo: it parses the served robot.xml for the 14 joints, the 14 actuator ctrlranges and the time step, then moves each actuated joint toward its control value; it computes no inertia, torque, contact, equality or actuator dynamics, so no trajectory here is a MuJoCo result
the stand-in loads no mesh or texture and resolves no contact: the eleven meshes of the model are not read, and the eight contact exclusions of the model are not applied

the served robot.xml is the bare two-arm torso; the RethinkGripper that the robosuite wrapper attaches to each arm (baxter_robot.py:27-31) is not part of this MJCF, so no gripper joint or gripper actuator is served
the model sets no option timestep; the stand-in uses a placeholder library default as the step (fake.py), and the bridge publishes that stand-in value from the stand-in
MuJoCo itself was not importable where the gate ran, so no trajectory of this package was compared with the real engine
no rendering, cameras or sensor publication: the robotview camera of the model is not exposed, and only the bridge's time, qpos, qvel and ctrl state is published
the multiple-controller split of Safe Multi-Agent Robosuite (README.md:10) is a wrapper over a robosuite scene; it is not part of this bare robot model and is not served
no physical Baxter robot is modelled and nothing was validated against the hardware
